faq.heading: Common House Painting Questions
faq.q1: How much does painting a double-storey terrace cost in Malaysia?
faq.a1: For a typical double-storey terrace (around 1,800 sqft of wall area), expect RM6,000 to RM10,000 including premium paint and labour.
faq.q2: Do you use Nippon, Jotun, or Dulux?
faq.a2: Yes, all three premium brands. Customers can choose based on budget and surface type.
faq.q3: How long does it take to repaint a house?
faq.a3: Bedroom or living room work: 5 hours. Single-storey terrace: 1–2 days. Double-storey: 2–4 days depending on size.
faq.a4: No. Site visits and quotes are free with no obligation.
faq.a5: 12-month warranty on all work. Scratches or peeling in that period are repainted free of charge.
faq.q6: Do you serve outside the Klang Valley?
faq.a6: Yes — we cover Penang, Johor Bahru, Ipoh, Melaka, and Seremban. Travel costs are bundled into the quote.
faq.q7: Can I choose my own colours?
faq.a7: Of course. Our team brings fan decks to site, or you can send WhatsApp inspiration photos.
faq.q8: Do you remove furniture during work?
faq.a8: We cover furniture with dust sheets. Heavy furniture should be moved by the customer for full wall access.
